payload.artist_html: M. Margulis-Ohnuma, A. A. Ruebenstahl, D. L. Meyer & B.-A. S. Bhullar
payload.credit_html: "A short-snouted 'sphenosuchian' with unusual feeding anatomy demonstrates that ecological specialization occurred early in crocodylomorph evolution"
payload.description_html: Line drawings and extracted renderings of the skull of Eosphorosuchus lacrimosa in right lateral view (a) and dorsal view (b), the posterior lower jaw in lateral view (c) and the palate in ventral view (d). Drawings were traced from photographs and show externally visible anatomy; renderings show digitally segmented elements in their preserved positions. The posterior half of the right nasal was too fragmentary to be reliably segmented and is excluded from the rendering. Additional abbreviations: anf, antorbital fenestra; antf, antorbital fossa; ch, choana; en, external nares; jln, jugal-lacrimal notch (filled by maxilla); jlr, jugal longitudinal ridge; mnf, mandibular fenestra; ms, maxillary shelf; orb, orbit; pl, palatine; por, postorbital ridge; ptvc, pterygoid ventral concavity; q, quadrate (displaced); sar, surangular ridge; sde, surangular convex dorsal edge; stfo, supratemporal fossa; v, vomer. Scale bar is 2 cm.
